description: Return only iso_week and us_week for one YYYY-MM-DD date. The response has those two numbers and nothing else: no date, weekday, year, or link. ISO weeks start on Monday, and week 1 contains the year's first Thursday: 2026-12-31 and 2020-12-31 are iso_week 53. The US week starts on Sunday, and 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year, so 2022-01-01 is iso_week 52 and us_week 1. 2027-01-01 is iso_week 53 and us_week 1.
name: week_number

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.
